```{r}
library(here)
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)

# 项目根定位（可选，保持和你截图里一样的结构）
here::i_am("Combining_clean_imputed_dataset_for_all_decedentstled.Rmd")
```

```{r}

# 一个小工具函数：给定模型目录与要抽取的预测列，返回精简过的 df
read_pred_csv <- function(model_dir, pred_col) {
  # 该模型下 results/ 里含 "clean" 的 csv
  files <- list.files(
    path = file.path(model_dir, "results"),
    pattern = "clean.*\\.csv$",
    full.names = TRUE
  )
  if (length(files) == 0) {
    stop(glue::glue("No 'clean*.csv' found under {model_dir}/results"))
  }
  if (length(files) > 1) {
    message(glue::glue("Found {length(files)} 'clean' files under {model_dir}/results; using the first one:\n{basename(files[1])}"))
  }

  df <- readr::read_csv(files[1], show_col_types = FALSE)

  # 只保留 projid, fu_year, 目标预测列
  if (!pred_col %in% names(df)) {
    stop(glue::glue("Column '{pred_col}' not found in {basename(files[1])}"))
  }

  df %>%
    dplyr::select(projid, fu_year, !!pred_col) %>%
    # 统一类型，避免 join 时出问题
    dplyr::mutate(
      projid = suppressWarnings(as.integer(projid)),
      fu_year = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(fu_year))
    )
}
```


```{r}

# 各模型目录与相应要抽取的列名 —— 按你的命名规则：
# BiLSTM_amyloid -> pred_amyloid
# BiLSTM_nia     -> pred_niareagansc
# LSTM_tangles   -> pred_tangles
# LSTMReLU_gpath -> pred_gpath
model_map <- tibble::tibble(
  dir = c("BiLSTM_amyloid", "BiLSTM_nia", "LSTM_tangles", "LSTMReLU_gpath"),
  pred = c("pred_amyloid",  "pred_niareagansc", "pred_tangles", "pred_gpath")
)

# 读取四张表并合并
pred_list <- purrr::pmap(model_map, ~ read_pred_csv(..1, ..2))

combined <- Reduce(
  function(x, y) dplyr::full_join(x, y, by = c("projid", "fu_year")),
  pred_list
) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(projid, fu_year)

# 看一眼结果
print(dplyr::glimpse(combined))

# 保存
out_path <- here::here("combined_clean_preds_only_for_decedents.csv")
readr::write_csv(combined, out_path)
message(glue::glue("Saved combined predictions to: {out_path}"))
```
